title: Hello
summary: USB serial diagnostic. Reports the chip, flash, PSRAM, and free heap; it does not initialize the display.

title: Display
summary: Cycles red, green, blue, white, and black screens to check the display panel.

title: Avatar animation
summary: Shows four generated pixel avatars with animated agent states and reports rendering speed over USB serial.

title: Touch
summary: Reads screen taps and prints their coordinates over USB serial.

title: Calculator
summary: Touchscreen calculator with decimal input, sign toggle, backspace, clear, and chained basic arithmetic.

title: Wi-Fi
summary: Shows a setup QR code for Espressif's phone app to provision 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Credentials are saved on the board.

title: Wi-Fi over BLE
summary: Use this page and the code shown on the board to securely set up 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi over Bluetooth.

title: Connectivity
summary: Touchscreen tools to scan for and join Wi-Fi networks, scan BLE devices, or advertise a BLE diagnostic device.

title: NVS
summary: Placeholder only: reports startup information but does not test nonvolatile storage yet.

title: SD card diagnostic
summary: Lists files from the FNK0104B four-bit SDIO card over serial without formatting it.

title: SD file manager
summary: Touchscreen SD browser with storage capacity and read-only text and hex file viewing.

title: MQTT
summary: Placeholder only: does not connect to an MQTT broker yet.

title: OTA
summary: User-confirmed HTTPS firmware update from a GitHub Release, with touchscreen and serial controls.

title: Codex monitor
summary: Shows Codex limits and agents, wakes on Hi ESP for local commands, and submits VAD-ended voice to a local bridge. Includes secure Web BLE Wi-Fi setup; preserves Arduino Wi-Fi storage and replaces OTA/FATFS data.

title: Audio
summary: Captures one second of onboard microphone audio at a time and reports signal detection; it never prints or saves samples.

title: Speaker keyboard
summary: Plays notes from a touchscreen keyboard with an adjustable speaker volume.

title: LocalLink
summary: Records speech with the onboard microphone, discovers a Speech Recognition service on your LAN, and shows the returned transcript. Requires Wi-Fi and a compatible service.

title: Screen timeout
summary: Turns the display backlight off after 60 seconds of inactivity and wakes it on touch.

title: Button
summary: Checks the verified expansion GPIO14 button input over USB serial.

title: Speech diagnostic
summary: Visual offline wake-word, command and VAD diagnostic.

title: Offline voice recorder
summary: Wake-triggered recording to SD with touch controls and Opus playback.

title: Recorder I/O diagnostic
summary: Exercises display, touch, microphone and SD before full recording.

title: USB-JTAG hello diagnostic
summary: Debug-oriented serial diagnostic; an actual breakpoint session remains UNKNOWN.

title: USB HID diagnostic
summary: Composite USB keyboard and serial diagnostic. Sends test input only when explicitly commanded.

title: Emoji and numpad keyboard
summary: Touchscreen USB number pad and OS-specific emoji shortcuts. Keyboard input verified directly on Windows 11; remote-session forwarding remains unverified.
